images.name: fire_spent_01
images.prompt: Edit IMAGE 2's spent-fire arrangement using IMAGE 1's four greyscale planes and hand-drawn contour weight. Preserve every piece, position, root, axis, tip and gap within 6 pixels. Repaint stubs as guttering flame with an irregular white heart. Request exactly 768×768 with genuine alpha transparency. No gradients, glow, blur, texture, scenery or added fragments. Retry correction: trace the guide more closely, narrow the detached top piece, correct displaced tongue tips and restore the original line weight.

retries.reason: Tongue contours drifted from the guide and contour weight changed.
retries.change: Repeated the edit from the original references with stronger silhouette tracing and line-weight constraints.

concerns: Output is 1254×1254, not the requested 768×768; copied unchanged without conversion or trimming.
An alpha channel is confirmed, but genuinely transparent background pixels were not independently verified.
Guide alignment within 6 pixels is not established; silhouette differences remain visible.
Visible tonal variation raises concerns about the exactly-four-flat-planes constraint.
